entries.title: Clanfolk
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC Early Access build

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC Early Access presentation.

primary.why: Clanfolk is currently documented as a Windows PC Steam Early Access colony/life sim. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. The Windows PC build is therefore the only sourced route, but it should be revisited when the game exits Early Access.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam Early Access build only if an in-progress archive run is acceptable; otherwise wait for the 1.0 release and revalidate.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Early Access release with active update support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform; provisional because the game is still in Early Access.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform split was found; the meaningful completeness caveat is Early Access status.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game: the archive route should be rechecked at 1.0 because content and balance can still change.
